'''R6-LE5''', also known as "'''Leefive'''," was an [[R6 astromech droid]] that served voluntarily in the [[Resistance]] in its [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]]. During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the Resistance and the [[First Order]], R6-LE5 and her counterpart [[R2-SHP]] carried out routine maintenance on the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'' while it was used as the base's command hub. In [[35 ABY]], R6-LE5 attended a meeting at the base where [[General]]s [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Finn]] laid out their plan for the [[Battle of Exegol]].

==Biography==
The [[R6 astromech droid]] known as R6-LE5 or "Leefive" served in the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. Counterpart to her "sibling" [[R2-SHP]], R6-LE5 was a [[Manumission|freed]] droid who served no master. The two carried out routine repairs and maintenance on the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'' while it acted as the command hub for the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]], ensuring the [[starship]] continued to function.<ref name="TROS VD" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> R6-LE5 attended a meeting held under the [[corvette]] in the base where [[general]]s [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Finn]] laid out their plan for [[Battle of Exegol|attacking]] the [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the [[Sith Eternal]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]. The Resistance [[Resistance navy|forces]] then mobilized and successfully defeated their foes.<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
[[File:ResistanceExegolMeeting-TROS.png|thumb|left|320px|R6-LE5 (right) served voluntarily in the Resistance.]]
R6-LE5 was less gregarious than R2-SHP and defined her service to the Resistance as strictly voluntary, although she followed rank hierarchy as dictated by Resistance protocols. She had [[Color|blue]] plating and a black [[sensor]] and was equipped with an [[Intellex VIII]] [[computer]] system housed in her dome. As an [[R-series]] droid,<ref name="TROS VD" /> R6-LE5 was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="AEYNK" />

==Behind the scenes==
R6-LE5 was created for the [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> released in [[December]] [[2019]].<ref name="Jedi Redeemed">{{InsiderCite|196|The Jedi Redeemed: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker|The Jedi Redeemed: ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker''}}</ref> The droid was revealed beforehand in a [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'']] pack of figures tied into the film and released by [[The Walt Disney Company]]<ref name="Toy">{{DisneyToyCite|set=Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=D-O · R5-2JE · R6-LE5 · R2-SHP|link=star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-droid-factory-figure-set-400911413423.html}}</ref> in [[November]] 2019.<ref name="ToyDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.jeditemplearchives.com/content/modules.php?name=JReviews&rop=showcontent&id=3855|text=D-O/R5-2JE/R6-LE5/R2-SHP - Droid Factory|author=Harrison, Paul|date=2019-12-12|work=[https://www.jeditemplearchives.com Jedi Temple Archives]|archivedate=20210116080954}}</ref> The droid was then identified as "Leefive" in ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released alongside the film.<ref name="TROS VD" />

[[File:R6-LE5_Interior.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The interior of R6-LE5's dome]]
Only R6-LE5's dome was made for the film;<ref name="R6-LE5-Prop">{{WebCite|url=https://usm.propstoreauction.com/m/lot-details/index/catalog/287/lot/73334|text=Lot # 345: Star Wars - EP IX - The Rise of Skywalker (2019) -Light-up R6-LE5 Dome|work=[https://usm.propstoreauction.com usm.propstoreauction.com]|archivedate=20210912084618}}</ref> the full droid was created by placing R6-LE5's on R2-SHP's body for additional scenes.<ref name="R2-SHP-Prop">{{WebCite|url=https://usm.propstoreauction.com/m/lot-details/index/catalog/287/lot/73333|text=Lot # 344: Star Wars - EP IX - The Rise of Skywalker (2019) - R2-SHP Light-up Remote Control Droid|work=[https://usm.propstoreauction.com usm.propstoreauction.com]|archivedate=20210912083900}}</ref> The dome is made of hand-painted resin and styrene with some metal adornments and elements that can illuminate and flash. The prop was intentionally tarnished in order to be in keeping with director [[George Lucas]]'s "used future" aesthetic and also suffered additional wear from use during filming, requiring repair to the exterior. The dimensions of the dome are 4.65 centimeters by 46.5 centimeters by 34 centimeters (18.25 inches by 18.25 inches by 13.5 inches). The droid's dome sold at auction for $10,000 in [[2021]].<ref name="R6-LE5-Prop" />
